cut.text: MAXALIGN is 8 bytes on all 64-bit platforms.
cut.reason: no official doc states the value; the page states it only as what the test server used and pins byte counts with tests

cut.text: lz4 compresses JSON N times faster than pglz.
cut.reason: no official benchmark figure; only the release notes' 'more efficient' wording
docs say 'about 2000 bytes'; exact value depends on build constants

cut.text: PostgreSQL has no way to reorder the columns of an existing table.
cut.reason: not stated explicitly in the docs; page only says reordering means copying into a new table

cut.text: On-disk TOAST pointers become 22 bytes with 8-byte OIDs.
cut.reason: only in the development branch (future version 20); not in 18 or 19
